# Literal/default constructor matches

Five originals are unchanged Apache-2.0 copies of pinned Bend
`e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599` tests/flatten/literal_default_000..004.
Oracle-derived normal forms, graphs and refusal text retain that attribution.
New adapters, wrappers and tests use MPL-2.0.

Applicability is observed before applications: original builds require Base;
separate Base-importing adapters reach function-printer refusal. The 45-input
grid has 4, 27, 4, 6 and 4 cases respectively. It checks literal/default priority,
three-column bindings, predecessor extraction and complete matched-value
reconstruction. Full imported constructors and scalar projections have separate
wrappers and complete graph/text oracles. Agreement on scalar observations does
not establish full-constructor printer parity for a timed-out upstream oracle.
